scripts.fallow:audit: sh -c 'if test -f .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; then fallow audit --format json --quiet --explain --gate-marker agent --dead-code-baseline .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; else fallow audit --format json --quiet --explain --gate-marker agent; fi'
scripts.fallow:coverage: npm run test && npm run fallow
scripts.fallow:ratchet: sh -c 'if test -f .fallow-health-baseline.json; then fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --baseline .fallow-health-baseline.json; else fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --report-only; fi'
scripts.fallow:raise: sh -c 'fallow health --coverage coverage/coverage-final.json --report-only --save-baseline .fallow-health-baseline.json; fallow dead-code --save-baseline .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json; test -f .fallow-health-baseline.json && test -f .fallow-dead-code-baseline.json'
